def _validate(entries):
    need(type(entries) is dict, 'index entries object required')
    leaves = set()
    directories = set()
    for name, row in entries.items():
        with refusal_context('validate', name):
            path = _name(name)
            need(type(row) is dict, 'index row object required')
            kind = row.get('kind')
            need(kind in ('file', 'symlink', 'directory'), 'index DATA kind')
            keys = {'kind', 'mode', 'bytes', 'sha256'} | ({'target'} if kind == 'symlink' else set())
            need(set(row) == keys, 'index row fields')
            _mode(row['mode'])
            need(type(row['bytes']) is int and 0 <= row['bytes'] <= PAYLOAD_CAP, 'index DATA size')
            need(type(row['sha256']) is str and len(row['sha256']) == 64 and all((c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in row['sha256'])), 'index DATA hash')
            if kind == 'directory':
                need(row['bytes'] == 0 and row['sha256'] == EMPTY, 'directory carries no payload')
                directories.add(name)
            else:
                leaves.add(name)
            if kind == 'symlink':
                need(type(row['target']) is str and row['target'] and ('\x00' not in row['target']) and (pin(row['target'].encode('utf-8')) == {k: row[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}), 'link-target DATA hash')
            for parent in path.parents:
                if parent != PurePosixPath('.'):
                    need(parent.as_posix() in entries and entries[parent.as_posix()]['kind'] == 'directory', 'missing explicit directory or leaf parent collision')
    need(len(leaves) <= LEAF_CAP and len(directories) + 1 <= DIR_CAP, 'capsule count cap')
    return (leaves, directories)
native/capsule.py.open_capsule:
def open_capsule(path):
    raw = _ordinary(path, CAP)
    need(len(raw) >= 10240 and len(raw) % 10240 == 0, 'truncated/noncanonical USTAR record length')
    index, offset = _take(raw, 0, 'index.json', INDEX_CAP)
    document = _load(index)
    need(type(document) is dict and set(document) == {'schema', 'root_mode', 'entries'} and (type(document['schema']) is int) and (document['schema'] == 1) and (_json(document) == index), 'noncanonical capsule index')
    root_mode = _mode(document['root_mode'])
    records = document['entries']
    need(type(records) is dict and len(records) <= LEAF_CAP + DIR_CAP - 1, 'bounded capsule entry map')
    entries = {}
    references = {}
    for name, record in records.items():
        need(type(record) is dict, 'capsule index row')
        row = dict(record)
        if row.get('kind') != 'directory':
            need('payload' in row, 'capsule payload reference required')
            references[name] = row.pop('payload')
        entries[name] = row
    leaves, _ = _validate(entries)
    payloads = {}
    for number, name in enumerate(sorted(leaves)):
        expected = 'data/%06d' % number
        need(references[name] == expected, 'canonical unique payload reference required')
        payload, offset = _take(raw, offset, expected, PAYLOAD_CAP)
        row = entries[name]
        need(pin(payload) == {k: row[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}, 'retained payload bytes/hash differs')
        if row['kind'] == 'symlink':
            need(payload == row['target'].encode('utf-8'), 'retained link-target DATA differs')
        payloads[name] = payload
    total = (offset + 1024 + 10239) // 10240 * 10240
    need(len(raw) == total and (not any(raw[offset:])) and (len(raw) - offset >= 1024), 'extra/truncated/noncanonical USTAR tail')
    return View(entries, payloads, root_mode)

def consumer_contract(row, own, image, root, output, uid, gid):
    h = row['HostConfig']
    labels = row['Config']['Labels']
    need(row['Name'] == '/developer-' + own['token'] and row['Image'] == image and (labels.get(LABEL) == own['token']) and (labels.get(LABEL + '.source') == own['source']) and (row['Config']['User'] == str(uid) + ':' + str(gid)), 'exact owned consumer identity')
    need(h['NetworkMode'] == 'none' and h['ReadonlyRootfs'] is True and (h['Privileged'] is False) and (h['PidsLimit'] == 256) and (h['Memory'] == 4 * 1024 ** 3) and (h['NanoCpus'] == 2000000000) and (set(h['CapDrop']) == {'ALL'}) and (not h.get('CapAdd')) and (h['SecurityOpt'] == ['no-new-privileges']) and (not h.get('Devices')) and (not h.get('DeviceRequests')) and (not h.get('VolumesFrom')), 'actual consumer resource/isolation limits')
    binds = {(m['Destination'], m['Source'], m['RW']) for m in row['Mounts'] if m['Type'] == 'bind'}
    need(binds == {('/source', str(root), False), ('/out', str(output), True)} and all((m['Type'] == 'bind' or (m['Type'] == 'tmpfs' and m['Destination'] == '/tmp') for m in row['Mounts'])) and (set(h['Tmpfs']) == {'/tmp'}) and (set(h['Tmpfs']['/tmp'].split(',')) == {'rw', 'nosuid', 'nodev', 'exec', 'size=2g'}), 'exact source/output/tmpfs mounts')

def input_contract(root):
    root = Path(root)
    profile = load(root / 'native/input-profile.json')
    raw = read(root / 'bootstrap/scripts/ci/inputs.lock.json')
    need(pin(raw)['sha256'] == INPUTS, 'original248 whole input pin')
    original = json.loads(raw)
    lock = read(root / 'native/original341.lock')
    need(pin(lock)['sha256'] == LOCK and len(lock.splitlines()) == 341, 'exact original341 inventory')
    versions = {r['name'][0]: r['version'][0] for r in original['rootfs_packages']}
    versions.update({r['name']: r['version'] for r in original['packages']})
    need(lock == ''.join((n + ' ' + v + '\n' for n, v in sorted(versions.items()))).encode(), 'original inventory derivation differs')
    extras = profile['additions']['rows']
    desktop_raw = read(root / 'native/desktop574-inputs.lock.json')
    need(pin(desktop_raw)['sha256'] == DESKTOP, 'whole retained574 supplementary input pin')
    desktop = json.loads(desktop_raw)
    need({r['name']: r for r in extras} == {r['name']: r for r in desktop['packages'] if r['name'] in EXTRAS}, 'exact retained8 rows and signatures differ')
    need(len(extras) == 8 and {r['name'] for r in extras} == EXTRAS and (not EXTRAS & versions.keys()), 'fixed eight package additions')
    available = set(versions) | EXTRAS
    for row in extras:
        need(row['arch'] in ('aarch64', 'any') and row['filename'].endswith('.pkg.tar.xz'), 'original ARM archive format')
        for key in ('sha256', 'signature_sha256'):
            need(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', row[key] or ''), 'exact archive/signature hash')
        for key in ('size', 'signature_size'):
            need(type(row[key]) is int and 0 < row[key] <= 64 * 1024 ** 2, 'finite archive/signature bytes')
        need(all((d in available for d in row['depends'])), 'complete name-only retained dependency closure')
        versions[row['name']] = row['version']
    expected = ''.join((n + ' ' + v + '\n' for n, v in sorted(versions.items()))).encode()
    need(read(root / 'native/expected349.lock') == expected and len(versions) == 349, 'exact augmented349 inventory')
    return (profile, original, expected)
native/common.py.verify_source:
def verify_source(root, checksum):
    root = Path(root).absolute()
    need(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', checksum or ''), 'explicit whole source-map hash required')
    raw = read(root / MAP)
    need(pin(raw)['sha256'] == checksum, 'whole source map differs')
    manifest = json.loads(raw)
    need(manifest['schema'] == 1 and manifest['actual'] == dict(source=None, ref=None, run=None), 'NULL unexecuted source selectors')
    rows = manifest['files']
    need(MAP not in rows and len(rows) <= 200, 'finite nonrecursive source map')
    actual = set()
    actual_dirs = set()
    for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        base = Path(directory)
        for name in tuple(dirs):
            need(not (base / name).is_symlink(), 'source directory alias')
            if base == root and name == '.git':
                dirs.remove(name)
            else:
                actual_dirs.add(str((base / name).relative_to(root)))
        for name in files:
            actual.add(str((base / name).relative_to(root)))
    need(actual == set(rows) | {MAP}, 'closed complete source namespace differs')
    expected_dirs = {str(p) for name in set(rows) | {MAP} for p in Path(name).parents if p != Path('.')}
    need(actual_dirs == expected_dirs, 'closed source directory namespace differs')
    for name, expected in rows.items():
        path = Path(name)
        need(not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts and (path.as_posix() == name), 'source path')
        need(pin(source_bytes(root, name)) == {k: expected[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')} and stat.S_IMODE((root / path).stat().st_mode) == expected['mode'], 'source bytes/mode differ: ' + name)
    return manifest

def admit(root, args, phase):
    verify_source(root, args.map_sha256)
    profile, _, _ = input_contract(root)
    own = binding(args.source_sha, args.ref, args.run_id, os.environ)
    need((phase == 'cache' or args.execute) and platform.system() == 'Linux' and (platform.machine() in ('aarch64', 'arm64')) and (os.getuid() == os.geteuid() != 0) and (os.environ.get('GITHUB_ACTIONS') == 'true') and (os.environ.get('RUNNER_ARCH') == 'ARM64') and (os.environ.get('RUNNER_OS') == 'Linux'), 'explicit same-source unprivileged native ARM workflow required')
    need(not any((k.startswith(('GIT_', 'LD_', 'DOCKER_', 'CACHY_OLD_FOUR_', 'CACHY_RETAINED_')) for k in os.environ)), 'ambient Git/loader/daemon/private transport overrides refused')
    temp = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']).absolute()
    ordinary_directory(temp)
    need(args.work == temp / 'native-developer-work' and args.cache == temp / 'alarm-cache' and (args.carrier == temp / 'pgo-hosted-retained') and (not temp.is_relative_to(root)) and (not root.is_relative_to(temp)), 'fixed external work/cache/full-carrier paths')
    need(not any((p.is_symlink() for p in (root, *root.parents, args.work, args.cache, args.carrier))), 'no input/output aliases')
    return (own, profile)

def validate(capsule_path, expected):
    need(type(expected) is dict and set(expected) == {'source', 'ref', 'run', 'map_sha256'} and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', expected.get('source') or '') and isinstance(expected.get('ref'), str) and expected['ref'].startswith('refs/heads/codex/') and re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*', expected.get('run') or '') and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', expected.get('map_sha256') or ''), 'NULL/unbound actual native evidence refused before reading')
    view = open_capsule(capsule_path)
    binding = {k: expected[k] for k in ('source', 'ref', 'run')}
    binding.update(attempt=1, token=hashlib.sha256((binding['source'] + ':' + binding['ref'] + ':' + binding['run']).encode()).hexdigest()[:24])
    manifest = view.load('artifacts.json')
    need(manifest['schema'] == 1 and manifest['binding'] == binding and (manifest['source_map_sha256'] == expected['map_sha256']), 'actual binding differs')
    files = manifest['files']
    need(type(files) is dict and all((type(row.get('bytes')) is int and row['bytes'] >= 0 and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', row.get('sha256') or '') for row in files.values())), 'typed artifact pins')
    need(0 < len(files) <= 3000 and sum((row['bytes'] for row in files.values())) <= 32 * 1024 ** 2, 'bounded artifact namespace')
    view.verify_manifest(manifest)
    if 'safe-diagnostic.json' in files:
        return retained_safe_diagnostic(view, files, binding, expected['map_sha256'])
    retained_public_projection(view, files, binding, expected['map_sha256'])
    if 'provision-diagnostic.json' in files:
        transport_phase = view.load('provision-diagnostic.json').get('phases', {}).get('input-transport-owner.json')
        if transport_phase is not None:
            retained_transport_diagnostic(view, files, transport_phase, binding, expected['map_sha256'])
    if 'provision-diagnostic.json' in files:
        diagnostic = view.load('provision-diagnostic.json')
        need(diagnostic['binding'] == binding and diagnostic['source_map_sha256'] == expected['map_sha256'] and (diagnostic['status'] == 'DIAGNOSTIC_HOSTED_INPUT_PROVISIONING_ONLY') and (diagnostic['native'] == diagnostic['GPG'] == diagnostic['ALPM'] == 'NOT_RUN'), 'actual DATA diagnostic only')
        return dict(status='VALIDATED_INPUT_PROVISIONING_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_NATIVE', binding=binding, native='NOT_RUN', physical_M2='NOT_RUN')
    receipt = view.load('receipt.json')
    cleanup = view.load('cleanup.json')
    need(receipt.get('binding') == binding and receipt.get('source_map_sha256') == expected['map_sha256'] and (type(receipt.get('status')) is str) and (type(cleanup.get('status')) is str), 'same-source owner and explicit cleanup outcome required')
    consumer_diagnostic = retained_consumer_diagnostic(view, files, receipt, binding, expected['map_sha256'])
    build_summary = retained_build_summary(view, files, binding, expected['map_sha256'])
    failed = receipt['status'] != 'PASS_NATIVE_DEVELOPER_COMPONENTS_ONLY' or cleanup['status'] != 'PASS_EXACT_OWNED_RESOURCES_RETIRED'
    need(failed or consumer_diagnostic['status'] != 'ABSENT_CONSUMER_DIAGNOSTIC_DATA_ONLY', 'successful owner cannot omit original consumer diagnostic')
    need(failed or build_summary['status'] != 'ABSENT_BUILD_SUMMARY_DATA_ONLY', 'successful owner cannot omit original build summary')
    if failed or not build_summary['positive_candidate']:
        return dict(status='VALIDATED_NATIVE_FAILURE_DATA_ONLY', binding=binding, owner_status=receipt['status'], cleanup_status=cleanup['status'], consumer_diagnostic=consumer_diagnostic, build_summary=build_summary, native='NOT_ADMITTED', physical_M2='NOT_RUN')
    if failed or not consumer_diagnostic['positive_candidate']:
        return dict(status='VALIDATED_NATIVE_FAILURE_DATA_ONLY', binding=binding, owner_status=receipt['status'], cleanup_status=cleanup['status'], consumer_diagnostic=consumer_diagnostic, native='NOT_ADMITTED', physical_M2='NOT_RUN')
    retained_consumer_diagnostic(view, files, receipt, binding, expected['map_sha256'], positive=True)
    retained_build_summary(view, files, binding, expected['map_sha256'], positive=True)
    retained_failure_data(view, files, receipt.get('bootstrap_failure_data'), binding, expected['map_sha256'])
    retained_image_lifecycle(view, files, receipt, cleanup, binding, expected['map_sha256'])
    need(receipt['binding'] == binding and receipt['source_map_sha256'] == expected['map_sha256'] and (receipt['status'] == 'PASS_NATIVE_DEVELOPER_COMPONENTS_ONLY') and (cleanup['status'] == 'PASS_EXACT_OWNED_RESOURCES_RETIRED'), 'all native components plus actual resource retirement required')
    runner = view.load('bootstrap-proof/bootstrap-runner.json')
    need(runner['kernel']['machine'] in ('aarch64', 'arm64') and runner['docker_server_arch'] in ('aarch64', 'arm64') and (runner['commit'] == binding['source']) and (runner['run_id'] == binding['run']) and (runner['docker_endpoint'] in ('unix:///var/run/docker.sock', 'unix:///run/docker.sock')) and (type(runner['page_size']) is int) and (runner['page_size'] > 0), 'actual native host/local daemon provenance')
    before = view.load('consumer-inspect.json')
    after = view.load('consumer-after.json')
    for row in (before, after):
        need(row['Id'] == receipt['consumer']['container'], 'retained exact consumer ID')
        consumer_contract(row, binding, receipt['consumer']['image'], receipt['source_root'], receipt['output_root'], runner['uid'], runner['gid'])
    need(after['State'] == receipt['consumer']['state'] and after['State']['Running'] is False and (after['State']['ExitCode'] == 0) and (after['State']['Status'] == 'exited'), 'actual completed consumer daemon state')
    phases = receipt['provisioning']
    retained_transport_proof(view, files, phases['transport'], binding, expected['map_sha256'])
    need(phases['proof']['status'] == 'PASS_EXACT_PUBLISHED_SOURCE_PROOF_ONLY' and phases['transport']['status'] == 'PASS_EXACT_RETAINED_INPUT_TRANSPORT_DATA_ONLY' and (phases['cache']['status'] == 'PASS_EIGHT_INPUT_CACHE_DATA_ONLY'), 'complete hosted source and input DATA provisioning')
    for phase in phases.values():
        need(phase['binding'] == binding and phase['source_map_sha256'] == expected['map_sha256'], 'all provisioning same exact source and run')
    for row in phases['proof']['actors'] + phases['transport']['actors'] + receipt['actors'] + cleanup['actors']:
        need(row.get('public_log') in files and files[row['public_log']]['kind'] == 'file', 'actor log must be a retained ordinary artifact')
        need(row['status'] == 'PASS' and row['exit'] == 0 and (row['natural_exit'] is True) and (row['group_absent'] is True) and (row['retirement'] == 'REAPED') and (row['exit_observed_via_waitpid'] is True) and (row['ownership_lost'] is False) and (row['forced_cleanup'] is False) and (row['leader_held_until_group_inspection'] is True) and (pin(view.read(row['public_log'])) == row['log_pin']), 'direct owned wait and retained actor output required')
    guest = view.load('journey/result.json')
    need(guest['status'] == receipt['status'] and guest['architecture'] == 'aarch64' and (guest['packages'] == receipt['input_inventory']) and (guest['physical_M2'] == 'NOT_RUN') and (guest['native_16K'] == 'NOT_QUALIFIED'), 'actual guest identity and non-hardware boundary')
    need(guest['python']['status'] == 'PASS_LOCAL_PYTHON_PEP517_WORKFLOW' and guest['python']['build_protocol'] == 'FORCE_PEP517_PRIVATE_PINNED_UV_BUILD_NO_BUILD_ISOLATION_NO_INDEX' and (guest['extension']['status'] == 'PASS_LOCAL_COMPILED_PYTHON_WORKFLOW') and (set(guest['build_systems']['project_workflows']) == {'cmake', 'meson'}) and ({r['status'] for r in guest['build_systems']['project_workflows'].values()} == {'PASS_REAL_PROJECT_WORKFLOW'}), 'all component outcomes including actual PEP517')
    for name, feature in [('python', guest['python']), ('extension', guest['extension']), ('build-systems', guest['build_systems'])]:
        need(feature['commands'], 'actual feature commands')
        for row in feature['commands']:
            log = 'journey/' + name + '/' + row['log']
            need(log in files and files[log]['kind'] == 'file' and (pin(view.read(log)) == row['log_pin']), 'raw feature command log pin differs')
            state = row['supervision']
            need(row['success'] is True and state['reaped'] is True and (state['ownership'] == 'REAPED') and (state['group_census'] == 'EMPTY_TWICE') and (state['output_complete'] is True) and (state['error'] is None) and (not state['timeout']) and (not state['signals']), 'feature owned retirement required')
    builds = [row['argv'] for row in guest['python']['commands'] if 'build' in row['argv']]
    need(builds and all(('--force-pep517' in row and '--no-build-isolation' in row and ('--offline' in row) and ('--no-index' in row) for row in builds)), 'actual forced offline PEP517 argv')
    need(guest['python']['installed_backend']['identity']['version'] == '0.11.28' and guest['python']['installed_backend']['identity']['builtin_frontend'] is False, 'real separate backend import identity')
    policy = uv_policy(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])
    frontend = next((row for row in policy['artifacts'] if row['role'] == 'frontend'))
    backend = next((row for row in policy['artifacts'] if row['role'] == 'backend'))
    need(guest['python']['frontend']['file'] == {k: frontend['member'][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')} and guest['python']['backend'] == backend, 'exact source-pinned frontend and separate backend receipt')
    installed = guest['python']['installed_backend']
    for name, expected_file in installed['files'].items():
        need(name.startswith('/out/journey/python/venv/'), 'backend receipt path confined to private venv')
        relative = name.removeprefix('/out/')
        need(relative in files and files[relative]['kind'] == 'file' and ({k: files[relative][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')} == expected_file), 'retained backend installation bytes')
    for member in backend['verified_members']:
        target = installed['identity']['backend'] if member['name'].endswith('.data/scripts/uv-build') else str(Path(installed['identity']['module']).parent / member['name'].removeprefix('uv_build/'))
        need(installed['files'].get(target) == {k: member[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}, 'actual backend binary/shim equals original wheel payload')
    return dict(status='VALIDATED_NATIVE_DEVELOPER_COMPONENT_EVIDENCE_ONLY', binding=binding, python_wheel='ACTUAL_PEP517_COMPONENT_PASS', native_16K='NOT_QUALIFIED', physical_M2='NOT_RUN', release='NOT_ADMITTED')
